notes: Fixed the connectivity problem: in the previous version some other_joins used 'id:port' strings as endpoints, which did not resolve to piece ids. All joins now use plain piece ids, with the port names given in the method text. The sub-assemblies (wheels/tyres, brush, roof, tank, vacuum, shovel, broom) are now all linked into one model.
Minifigure (head, helmet, torso, legs) is shown in the booklet but is not in the 60-piece parts list, so it is omitted.
Counts verified against the parts list: 60 pieces; each type appears exactly as listed.
The booklet's small isometric pictures make exact stud placement ambiguous; rests_on for chassis bricks/plates (b4-b26) is a best-effort reading.
Roof (b39-b46) is a separate sub-assembly (pages 12-13) attached via hinge b39/b38; b46 windscreen hangs under the roof.
Wheel holders b13/b14 mount under the base plate b1 (clutch it from below).
Broom (b48) and shovel (b47) clip to b26/b25 (assumption); the vacuum nozzle assembly (b56-b60) is built on page 18 and attached on page 19; the pin b58 as the nozzle side nub is an interpretation.

notes: Minifigure (head, helmet, torso, legs, steering interaction) is shown in the booklet but is not in the 60-piece parts list, so it is omitted.
Counts verified against the parts list: 60 pieces; each type appears exactly as listed.
The booklet's small isometric pictures make exact stud placement ambiguous; rests_on for chassis bricks/plates (b4-b26) is a best-effort reading.
Roof (b39-b46) is built as a separate sub-assembly (pages 12-13) and attached via hinge b39/b38; b46 windscreen hangs under the roof.
b27-b30 wheels and tyres are one 4x group (page 8) with wheel holders b13/b14 mounted under the base plate; wheel holder plates clutch b1 from below.
Broom (b48) and shovel (b47) are clipped to clip bricks b26/b25 (assumption); the vacuum nozzle assembly (b56-b60) is built on page 18 and attached on page 19.
Part-to-part assignment of the lone Technic pin b58 (side nub of nozzle) and clip/bar joins on the vacuum is an interpretation of the pictures.
